engine_wire.response: EngineEgressAdmissionResponseV1 {schema_version: 1, disposition, body?, refusal?, classification?, receipt?}
engine_wire.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; request is plain JSON because model requests carry fractional numbers

invariants: a refused request carries a refusal and no body; an admitted one a body object and no refusal
an unknown principal carries no id; every other principal kind requires one
exactly a delivered receipt names the delivered context digest
blocked_objects equals the deny decisions and quarantined_objects the quarantine decisions
selected <= permitted and permitted + blocked <= inspected
every non-allow decision has at least one reason code
coverage never inspects more than the object holds; complete inspects every byte, partial not
a failed or timed-out detector cannot claim complete coverage
signals carry counts only, never the matched value

a receipt is schema_version 1 or 2; exactly a schema_version 2 receipt carries object_digest {algorithm: hmac-sha256, key_id: rk-<32 hex>} and names its decision objects by HMAC-SHA256 under that installation key
callers_must: send admission.body, never the original body

conformance.fixtures: fixtures/gateway-preview-v1 (valid: real Engine output; invalid: one violated invariant each)
conformance.live: every SDK runs the same three journeys against a real Engine when LEANCTX_ENGINE_BINARY is set
